title: Toonvara Video Definition v1.0
description: Schema for Toonvara video project JSON files. Covers the six required top-level fields (schema_version, project, video, assets, scenes, output) and their nested structures. Semantic cross-field validation (asset reference resolution, unique character IDs within a scene, action timing within scene bounds) is enforced at the application layer, not in this schema.

schema_version.description: Schema version identifier. Must be "1.0" for this schema revision.

scenes.description: Ordered list of scenes that compose the video.

seed.description: Seed for deterministic procedural features. Does not guarantee bit-identical output across renderers or hardware.

characters.description: Map of character asset ID to project-relative file path (GLB/glTF).

assets.description: Asset declarations referenced by scenes. Keys are stable asset identifiers; values are project-relative paths.

start_frame.description: Frame at which this scene begins (inclusive). Must be non-negative.

duration_frames.description: Number of frames in this scene. Must be positive.

characters.description: Character instances placed in this scene.

scene.description: A single scene within the video, spanning a contiguous range of frames.

id.description: Unique instance identifier within this scene.

position.description: World-space position [x, y, z]. Coordinate system: right-handed, Y-up, meters.

rotation.description: Euler rotation in degrees [x, y, z].

visible.description: Whether this character instance is visible.

actions.description: Scheduled animation actions. Intervals are start-inclusive, end-exclusive.

character_instance.description: A character placed in a scene with position, orientation, and scheduled actions.

clip.description: Animation clip name. Must exist in the character's available clips.

fallback_clip.description: Explicit replacement clip if clip is missing. The fallback must exist.

speed.description: Finite positive source-animation speed multiplier. Scheduled start and duration do not change.

loop.description: Wrap source animation time; false plays once and holds the last pose until the scheduled end.

blend_in_frames.description: Fade-in duration in timeline frames (less than duration_frames), independent of speed. Overlaps must exactly match this duration; at most two actions may overlap.

start_frame.description: Frame at which this action begins (relative to scene start, inclusive). Must be non-negative.

duration_frames.description: Duration in frames. Must be positive.

character_action.description: A single animation action scheduled on a character.

position.description: Camera position in world space [x, y, z].

target.description: Point the camera looks at [x, y, z].

fov.description: Vertical field of view in degrees. Only meaningful for perspective projection.

format.description: Output video format. Currently only "mp4" is supported.

path.description: Output file path (project-relative). Must not contain absolute paths or path-traversal sequences.
